pack: Suno faction voice packs for Black Sect, Sulgogars, Ghorkov and Taerkasten: REAPER v03-v05 plus FFmpeg v06
collaboration: Coda built the REAPER lab, the v02 cuts, the Black Sect and Sulgogar production plan and the reviewed cue contract. Red generated the remaining Black Sect and Sulgogar takes, wrote, generated and selected the Ghorkov and Taerkasten packs and the Black Sect message-19 lines, verified the cuts, rendered them natively in REAPER and integrated them. Coda recovered the existing Taerkasten r2 takes by normal-speed PCM playback capture and finished the two idle cues with FFmpeg. Andrei listened to the exact selected pair and adopted both on 2026-11-13.
listening_status: Andrei approved the earlier Black Sect/Sulgogar and v04 Ghorkov/Taerkasten/new Black Sect reels. The 53 retained v5 recuts still await explicit listening acceptance. On 2026-11-13 he listened to the exact selected v06 Taerkasten idle pair and chose: Use both selected takes. That direct human choice adopts these two files only. The designated base.en/small.en/medium.en panel remains incomplete for them; partial base.en/turbo evidence and the idle-2 as/a disagreement remain recorded. No Lily listening approval is claimed. In-game speech-bus acceptance remains pending.
level_policy: v03-v05: -18 LUFS routine / -17 LUFS for Sulgogar events whose duration target starts at 0.8 s, true peak <= -3.5 dBFS before export, gain capped at +12 dB (three quiet Sulgogar calls stay below target). Ghorkov and Taerkasten use the -18 LUFS target. Their gains were set on the v04 windows; the v05 re-cut only trims sound outside the words and closes pauses, so the gains were kept. v06 idle cues: static attenuation targeting -18.3 LUFS on the 48 kHz stereo/dual-mono rendering, with the finishing ceiling set to -1.5 dBTP. The actual final runtime files measure -18.46/-18.41 LUFS dual mono and -3.58/-4.23 dBTP; these recorded values are not listening approval.
black_voice: Suno v6 (Songs Advanced, spoken word, male) takes separated with Demucs htdemucs vocal stems; four lines are Coda v02 cuts of her own Suno vocal estimates. Message 19 lines: Black Sect Production 08 (Suno v6, Coda's Production 01 prompt), htdemucs vocal stem.
sulg_provenance: Suno v6 creature-call takes used unseparated; three Coda v02 salvage fragments kept.
ghorkov_voice: Suno Speech (beta), male, background music off, variety off. Each script puts a short Russian radio phrase and an ellipsis paragraph before every English line; the Russian phrases are cut away and never ship. Six of the twelve takes carried a low drone bed despite music off; 20 of the 32 cues are htdemucs vocal stems of those takes (music_under_voice_db gives the bed level). One cue, enemy_unit_engaged_1 "Enemy in retreat.", comes from a dry-run pilot take (pilot_ru8c) with older tone wording whose exact text was not saved.
taerkasten_voice: Suno Speech (beta), male, background music off, variety off, with German priming phrases removed. Of the 30 v5 cues, 24 use htdemucs vocal stems from s1-s4 takes that carried a drone bed; six r1 cues use a dry tone with no bed. The two v06 idle cues use normal 1x PCM playback capture of existing take 3f2bd9d9-47f1-46c9-9a55-76a7bd509c49 (r2), finished with FFmpeg without stem separation or time-stretch.
accent_method: Suno ignores accent wording in the tone, so the L1 priming phrase carries the accent. The check is Whisper small language ID. Calibrated on the GMU Speech Accent Archive (six speakers per group, 2 s chunks padded like the final files, per-speaker medians; calibrate_lid.py): native English speakers P(ru) 0.0001-0.0006 and P(de) 0.0002-0.0007, Russian second-language speakers P(ru) 0.0025-0.15, German second-language speakers P(de) 0.0012-0.011. Measured like the final files, a native-English control (the 32 Black Sect files and 25 retail English clips) reads P(ru) median 0.0012 (max 0.0061) and P(de) median 0.0011 (max 0.0064). Ghorkov reads about five times that median, with 15 of 32 lines above every control clip; Taerkasten about twice, with 6 of 30 above, which cannot confirm a German accent. It is a cue, not a measurement of how strong the accent sounds.
selection: Automated selection policy used for v03-v05: Whisper word alignment locates each line; the cut sits at the silence around its vocal island. An edge audit transcribes and language-identifies every island in the cut (envelope above the cut peak - 30 dB, merged across 0.15 s, at least 0.05 s long). It trims priming phrases and other non-line islands outside the first and last line island; noise islands between the words are kept, and a priming phrase between them rejects the cut. Fainter or shorter sounds, such as soft breaths and low thumps, never form an island. The v05 re-cut removes only sound more than 40 dB below the cut peak, so it keeps such sounds when they are louder; the inhales and thumps the audio review found were cut out with explicit windows. A residue check rejects cuts with sound outside the line's words. A cut is eligible only if base.en, small.en and medium.en, transcribing it in isolation, hear exactly the planned line in at least two of three cases. The two v06 idle cues are instead adopted by Andrei's direct listening choice on 2026-11-13. Their designated three-model panel remains incomplete; the partial base.en/turbo transcripts do not satisfy or replace that gate.
music_under_voice_db: Demucs accompaniment (no_vocals) minus vocal-stem level over the shipped cut, pads included, for cues cut from htdemucs vocal stems. The version 4 Black Sect values were measured over the vocal island only.

v03.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz.

v04.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; the bridge mailbox was driven by file transfer because the device shell was unavailable. Per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz.
v04.note: First render of the Ghorkov, Taerkasten and Black Sect message-19 cues. An audio review then found mid-line pauses, a leading inhale, low thumps at three cut edges (htdemucs leakage of the drone bed) and long near-silent tails. One cue still ships from this run: ghorkov-mp/order_ack_enemy_2.wav (see its edit).

v05.method: Native REAPER 7.79 render through the TwelveTake bridge; the bridge mailbox was driven by file transfer because the device shell was unavailable. Per-cue sample windows cut by cue_export.finalize; ffmpeg pan/resample to PCM16 mono 22050 Hz. 54 cues were re-cut. The other 40 (all 32 Black Sect cues and 8 Ghorkov/Taerkasten cues) re-rendered byte-identical to v04, and the 30 carried Black Sect cues are byte-identical to v03. A second review reverted one re-cut (ghorkov-mp/order_ack_enemy_2.wav), which ships from v04.

v06.method: Headless FFmpeg finishing of selected normal-speed browser PCM playback captures: reviewed source windows, static gain, linear fades, and PCM16 mono 22050 Hz conversion. No speech time-stretch or new generation.
v06.project_note: The editable REAPER project was preserved; it was not natively saved/rendered for these final files.
v06.source_provenance: Rendered Suno browser playback captures; not established original downloaded master.
v06.adoption: Andrei directly listened to the exact selected pair and chose both on 2026-11-13. Other v5 recut hearing and in-game acceptance remain open.

previous: Version 5 contained 126 cues and two Taerkasten idle fallbacks. Version 6 adds only the two directly selected v06 idle files; all previous cue entries and bytes are unchanged. Version 4 (Black Sect and Sulgogars only) is in this branch history up to 09f42e7, and version 3 up to 08acec3.
